checks.text: On initial load, the page displays the heading "Card Memory Match", a grid of 16 face-down cards, the text "Score: 0", and the text "Best: 0".
Clicking the card in the first row, first column (top-left) reveals the symbol "A" and changes its background to white; the text "Score: 0" remains unchanged.

With the top-left card (symbol "A") already face-up, clicking the card in the first row, second column reveals the symbol "B"; since the symbols differ, both cards flip back to face-down after 1 second, and the text "Score: 0" remains unchanged.

With the top-left card (symbol "A") already face-up, clicking the card in the fourth row, fourth column (bottom-right) reveals the symbol "A"; since the symbols match, both cards remain face-up, and the text "Score: 0" changes to "Score: 1".
With the top-left card (symbol "A") already face-up, clicking the top-left card again does nothing; the card remains face-up showing "A", and the text "Score: 0" remains unchanged.
Clicking the button labelled "Restart" resets the board to 16 face-down cards, changes the text "Score: 1" to "Score: 0", and keeps the text "Best: 1" unchanged.
Pressing the key "r" while the game is active resets the board to 16 face-down cards, changes the text "Score: 1" to "Score: 0", and keeps the text "Best: 1" unchanged.
After matching one pair (Score: 1), reloading the page still shows the text "Score: 1", the text "Best: 1", and the two matched cards (top-left and bottom-right) remain face-up showing "A".
Reload keeps the best score: after matching one pair (Score: 1, Best: 1) and reloading, the page displays the text "Best: 1" and the text "Score: 1".
